mainline_position.secondary_candidate: CP-CATF image-only with causal probe and strict image no-op safety
mainline_position.sampler_only_reason: Sampler-only is a training sampling intervention and hard-example/weighted-sampling mechanism. It changes the train distribution and is not equivalent to image data augmentation.

seed2_failure_interpretation.summary: Seed2 remains the blocking case for the image-augmentation mainline.
seed2_failure_interpretation.reason: High-risk image augmentation improved Precision but reduced Recall and mAP, indicating non-active regression and unsafe class/operation transfer.
seed2_failure_interpretation.known_risk_pattern: Earlier root-cause audits localized the fixed CATF-v2 seed2 failure to risky image-space texture/ROI intervention and non-active class regression, including class-9 texture-path risk.
allowed_repair_direction: weak image augmentation / attenuation by reducing prob and strength
strict image no-op when risk is high
forbidden_repair_direction: weighted index list as main method
hard example mining as paper main result

conclusion: fixed CATF-v2 is the current image-augmentation mainline baseline. Seed0 and seed1 show that CATF image augmentation has real potential, while seed2 shows the strategy still needs image-space risk control. Sampler-only is demoted to engineering exploration/ablation and must not be used as the paper main method.
